content.value: . A gas turbine power plant is operating on Brayton cycle has a pressure ratio of 8. The gas temperature is 300 K at the compressor inlet and 1300 K at the turbine inlet. Assuming a compressor efficiency of 80% and turbine efficiency of 85%, determine (i) the gas temperature at the exits of the compressor and the turbine, (ii) the back work ratio, and (iii) the thermal efficiency of the turbine.
